mapper.sql: P.ID AS PROMPT_ID ,P.VERSION ,P.BASE_VERSION ,P.CONTENT ,P.STATUS ,P.ANALYSIS_JSON ,P.CHANGES_JSON ,P.EVAL_JSON ,P.SCORE_OLD ,P.SCORE_NEW ,P.RECOMMEND_YN ,P.DOWN_COUNT ,P.DECIDED_BY ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM P.DECIDED_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS DECIDED_AT ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM P.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS INS_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_AI_PROMPT P WHERE 1=1 AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT FROM T_AI_PROMPT P WHERE 1=1 AND P.VERSION = #{version}
SELECT FROM T_AI_PROMPT P ORDER BY P.VERSION DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE T_AI_PROMPT SET STATUS = 'RETIRED' WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT L.ID AS CHAT_ID ,L.USER_ID ,L.QUESTION ,L.ANSWER ,L.TOOLS_USED ,L.RATING FROM T_AI_CHAT_LOG L WHERE 1=1 AND L.RATING = 'UP' ORDER BY L.ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT L.PROMPT_VERSION AS VERSION ,COUNT(*)::INT AS CHAT_COUNT ,COUNT(L.RATING)::INT AS RATED_COUNT ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE L.RATING = 'UP')::INT AS UP_COUNT ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE L.RATING = 'DOWN')::INT AS DOWN_RATED_COUNT FROM T_AI_CHAT_LOG L WHERE 1=1 AND L.INS_DAY >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY L.PROMPT_VERSION ORDER BY L.PROMPT_VERSION DESC
